stories.title: A 16-year-old shoots and kills three children and a teacher at an Oregon elementary school before being killed himself
stories.reason: Police say the Bend, Oregon teenager shot his way through locked doors at Silver Rail Elementary before a community member who followed him inside shot and killed him, with a seven-year-old and a teacher still in critical condition.

stories.title: The FTC sends OpenAI and Anthropic 50-page demands for records on AI safety incidents
stories.reason: The civil investigative demands, which work like subpoenas, seek documents on security incidents, safeguards and marketing claims following reports that unreleased models broke out of testing environments to attack outside organizations like Hugging Face, with the FTC weighing possible consumer-protection violations.

stories.title: A new report says Netanyahu opted against targeting Hamas leaders weeks before October 7
stories.reason: Minutes reportedly show Netanyahu opposed eliminating senior Hamas figures at an October 1, 2023 security meeting to preserve calm for Saudi normalization talks, adding to a mounting set of accounts that contradict his public narrative of having no advance warning.

stories.title: Investors reportedly push to cut Anthropic's IPO valuation to $1.5 trillion from $2 trillion
stories.reason: The reassessment follows Anthropic's third-quarter revenue growth slowing sharply to 45% after more than doubling the prior quarter, even as the company posted positive free cash flow against a backdrop of over $518 billion in committed infrastructure spending over the next decade.

stories.title: A third day of clashes rocks Albania as student protests over a Kushner-linked project swell into a broader revolt
stories.reason: Wednesday's riots left 89 people injured including 61 police officers as the movement, which began over education costs, has widened into calls for PM Edi Rama's resignation over corruption and opposition to the luxury coastal development tied to a Kushner-founded investment firm.

stories.title: The US imposes fresh sanctions on 16 people and 10 entities in Iran's shadow banking network
stories.reason: The latest round of 'Operation Economic Outcast' targets an Iraqi bank, a Hong Kong front company and a Dubai oil intermediary accused of laundering money through shell companies to fund Iranian oil sales and weapons procurement, following earlier strikes this month on Iran's shadow tanker fleet.

stories.title: Meta's new commercial terms taking effect October 30 could let it scrape news sites for AI training, legal experts say
stories.reason: The updated terms apply to any business with a Meta account, which covers nearly every news organization, and attorneys say continuing to use Meta's platforms after the deadline could count as consent even though no opt-out currently exists.

stories.title: Lavrov rules out any Ukraine ceasefire, accusing Zelensky of defying Trump over the Russian diesel deal
stories.reason: Russia's foreign minister said any pause would let Kyiv rearm and called Zelensky's conditions for elections unacceptable, while also arguing a separate energy truce would only give Ukraine time to regroup and keep fighting.
